changelog:
- Expanded scope to explicitly support migration toward any modern frontend stack, including React, Vue, Next.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, or modernized MPA.
- Added new structured references for migration strategy, mapping, and execution checklist, shifting detailed guidance out of SKILL.md and into dedicated files.
- Updated constraints to clarify requirements for code, visual, and functional verification; now mandates automated or manual regression checks for key user flows.
- Refined guidance around icons, images, and inline styles, allowing well-justified exceptions and defining validation procedures.
- Removed inlined concept mapping tables and phased migration steps from SKILL.md—these are now loaded from external reference files for better maintainability.
- skill-card.md removed; migration documentation and references now provided through updated materials.
